# Pega to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences


Pega to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences


**WALTHAM, Mass. – July 30, 2026 –**[Pegasystems Inc.](https://www.pega.com/) (NASDAQ: PEGA), the enterprise AI software company for mission-critical work, today announced that Alan Trefler, founder and CEO; Ken Stillwell, COO and CFO; and Don Schuerman, CTO, will be presenting at the following upcoming investor conferences:


- **Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference** ([https://event.summitcast.com/view/2na8Ek6QZtsJoeqs2JckGv/WWdubAqLaah7MMfQw6BgHe](https://event.summitcast.com/view/2na8Ek6QZtsJoeqs2JckGv/WWdubAqLaah7MMfQw6BgHe) ). Ken Stillwell will host a virtual Pega presentation, scheduled for Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 9:05 a.m. EDT (6:05 a.m. PDT).
- **Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference** ([https://event.summitcast.com/view/WuFmFdTcA9mVsUGHZJFU62/nC2vsMhGDwfaxz6SicrByf](https://event.summitcast.com/view/WuFmFdTcA9mVsUGHZJFU62/nC2vsMhGDwfaxz6SicrByf) ). Alan Trefler and Ken Stillwell will host an in-person Pega presentation, scheduled for Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. EDT (11:00 a.m. PDT) in Boston, MA.
- **Rosenblatt 6th Annual Technology Summit: The Age of AI** ([https://event.summitcast.com/view/UwudndjQDVnspUEzk3piXK/6bcKLucorWAPGXJUDWYiHx](https://event.summitcast.com/view/UwudndjQDVnspUEzk3piXK/6bcKLucorWAPGXJUDWYiHx) ). Don Schuerman will host a virtual Pega presentation, scheduled for Monday, August 17, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. EDT (8:00 a.m. PDT).


Archives of the presentations will be available from the[Investors page](https://www.pega.com/about/investors) of[Pega’s website](https://www.pega.com/) for a limited time.
